public.app-category.productivity
Jarvis lets Claude read and add calendar events when you ask, for example to check whether you are free on Friday afternoon or to book a meeting.
Jarvis adds events to your calendar when you ask Claude to, for example to save a meeting it scheduled for you.
Jarvis uses the camera to scan the pairing QR code printed by `jarvisd hub pair`, for example when you first connect to your hub.
Jarvis lets Claude look up your contacts when you ask, for example to find a colleague's phone number or email before drafting a message.
Jarvis lets Claude read health summaries when you ask, for example how many steps you walked this week or how long you slept last night.
Jarvis only reads health data and never writes it; if a future version saves data, for example a workout Claude logs for you, it will ask here first.
Jarvis shares your current location with Claude only when you ask, for example to find what time it is where you are or which office you are in.
Jarvis uses the microphone for voice input when you hold the mic button, for example to dictate a message to Claude while walking.
Jarvis saves images Claude produces to your library when you ask, for example a chart it generated.
Jarvis lets Claude look at recent photos when you ask, for example to read a screenshot you took or describe a whiteboard photo.
Jarvis lets Claude read and create reminders when you ask, for example to add “review the PR” to your Today list.
Jarvis turns your voice into text when you hold the mic button, for example to dictate a reply to Claude.
